comment: Agent NDA signatures, acceptance, acts, states and the bound test, with real Ed25519 signatures (agentnda.net 0.2.0-draft, 5.1, 6, 6.1, 6.2, 7.1, 7.3, 8.1). The documents are the specification's example (Harbor & Line Outfitters' open offer and Caldera Freight Systems' acceptance, byte for byte as nda-offer.json pins them) and agreements built from it. Every signature is real: the keys are derived from the published seeds below, and Ed25519 is deterministic, so any implementation reproduces each sig byte for byte. The test seeds are public by design and sign nothing else. A sig is the canonical padded base64 of the 64-byte signature, over the record it sits in with sig removed (6) or, for an act, over the act and its signature record with sig removed (7.3). mandates is what a lookup answers for the one mandate the fixtures cite (Agent Mandate 7.2): a record that cites it counts for an organization seat only when its key is the mandate's holder_key, the mandate is for the seat's organization, holds nda, and was in force at the record's signed_at. Every expected answer is written from the specification, not computed by an implementation. THE FIXTURE IS THE AUTHORITY: change it only with a spec change alongside.
spec: Agent NDA 0.2.0-draft: 5.1 (owner_key), 6 (signatures and binding), 6.1 (acceptance), 6.2 (mandates), 7.1 (states), 7.3 (acts), 8 (references), 8.1 (whether a party is bound); Agent RFP 0.10.0-draft 5.11.3 checks 1 to 5

keys.comment: Each seed is the SHA-256 of its label, as UTF-8. seed_hex is the raw 32-byte Ed25519 seed and public the public key in the family's spelling. The seeds are given as hex only, so that no secret-shaped string sits in the fixture. The agent keys of Harbor & Line and Caldera Freight are the stand-ins the specification prints and have no seed; they never sign, because owners sign.

signatures.comment: 6: a record verifies when its digest is the digest of the bytes it covers (the offer digest for a record marked over: offer, the agreement digest otherwise) and its sig verifies over 'agent-nda-sig-v1', one newline, and the JCS of the record minus sig. bound says whether the key is bound to the seat: the seat's owner_key, or for an organization seat the holder_key of the cited mandate, read from mandates. A record counts for its seat only when it verifies and is bound.

cases.why: the recipient's record covers the completed document, so its digest is the agreement digest
signed_at is inside the record the signature covers
the offer digest re-derived from a changed document is not the digest the discloser's record carries
the signature is good, but the key is not the recipient seat's owner_key
the signature is good, but the key is not the holder_key of the mandate the record cites

acceptance.comment: 6.1: the five checks a verifier runs on an acceptance, in order, with the mandates above; the first that fails is reported. resolve maps a handle to the agent key it currently names, for step 4. received_at, where a case gives one, is the instant the verifier received the acceptance; a verifier that holds that instant checks step 3 against it instead of signed_at (Agent RFP 5.11.3).

cases.why: any change beyond parties.recipient and disclosure.recipient changes the offer digest, and the discloser's record no longer covers it
the offer was signed by a key that is not the mandate's holder_key
moving signed_at earlier after signing breaks the recipient's signature
signed_at is before expires_at, but the verifier received the acceptance after it, and a signer writes its own signed_at
the offer was withdrawn on 2026-10-21, and Caldera signed on 2026-10-22
a withdrawal leaves acceptances made before it standing
the verifier received the acceptance after the withdrawal it holds

act_checks.comment: 7.3: an act is { act, signature }. It verifies over 'agent-nda-act-v1', one newline, and the JCS of the act with signature.sig removed; names the agreement by id, version and digest (the offer digest for a withdrawn open offer, the completed agreement's digest otherwise, since acceptances of one offer share an identifier); names the acting seat in by, with agent for a member; is signed by a key bound to that seat (6); carries a mandate where the seat names an organization (6.2); and, for a withdrawal of an open offer, is by the discloser. act_bytes pins the signed bytes of one act.

cases.why: the reason changed after signing
the signature record is inside the act's signed bytes
an act on one acceptance carries that acceptance's digest
by names the recipient seat, and the key is not its owner_key
by names Tidewater's seat, and the key is Northgate's owner_key
a one-way agreement has no member seats
Harbor & Line's seat names an organization, so its acts carry a mandate
an open offer is the discloser's to withdraw

states.comment: 7.1: the state derived from signatures, acts and instants at now. effective_at is when the duties began (effective_at, or the last required signature), ended_at when the agreement stopped covering new disclosures, duties_end_at that plus the survival period (5.2), counted in days of 86,400 seconds.

cases.why: notice_days 30 from 2027-03-01T12:00:00Z; survival 730 days from then
a renderer MUST NOT show one signature as in force
two members remain
the agreement stays in force among the others while at least two remain; after the third member left on 2027-04-01 one remained, and one member alone is no agreement

bound.comment: 8.1: is this party bound by the named agreement at now? rule 1, it signed a seat; rule 2, the reference is an open offer and it is the recipient of an acceptance that passes 6.1; rule 3, it is the subcontractor of a flow-down agreement that passes the strictness test of 5.5 and names an agreement binding the party above it. The agreement must be in force. documents lists what the caller holds.

cases.why: the only acceptance was signed by a key that is not the seat's owner_key
survival 365 days against 730 upstream

gate.comment: Agent RFP 0.10.0-draft 5.11.3, checks 1 to 5: what a board checks about the agreement before it releases a gated body. Check 6, that the posting is open and addresses the provider, is the board's own. The gate names the offer by its offer digest. poster is the posting's poster.agent; requester is the agent key on the request's transport identity; received_at is when the board received the completed agreement, which it records and checks expiry and withdrawal against.

cases.why: the board received the acceptance after expires_at; the signed_at the recipient wrote does not move that
